The buying guide

Written byDavid, Founder
NoteOn practice
DrawingsHPO.TECH

Most enquiries open with a model name. The model is the last thing to settle. A hyperbaric system is a pressure vessel plus three or four cabinets of plant, going into a building that was designed for something else, and the decisions arrive in an order. Two of them cannot be revisited once the system is in production.

The room, before the model

A single-seat Zeugma is 1,368 mm long, 1,988 mm across and 1,853 mm high. A four-seat Mediterranean is 3,220 mm long on the same 1,988 mm shell. Those are the vessels. The plant stands separately: an air compressor, an oxygen concentrator and an air cooler on a single-seat system, with a fourth cabinet from four seats up. The largest is 800 × 450 × 850 mm and weighs 97 kg.

The plant does not have to be in the treatment room. Up to 15 m of pipework separates it from the chamber, which is nearer 10 m across a plan once the run goes up a wall and along a ceiling. A cupboard, a store or an adjacent room will usually do, and this is the single fact that saves rooms people had written off.

Every module passes an 800 mm door. A system arrives assembled, is taken apart to get in, and is rebuilt in the room. On a four-seat system the largest single piece measures 2 m by 800 mm. If that will not navigate the stair, the stair comes off its fixings for a day, or the chamber goes down a lightwell, or through a removed window, or up a lift shaft with the car moved out of the way. All four have been done. The survey exists to find out which one applies.

Capacity decides the plant

Seats are not only a question of throughput. One oxygen concentrator is required per seat, to a maximum of four, and each one draws 1.8 kW. Electrical load runs 7.3 kW at a single seat, 9.1 kW at two and 13.9 kW at four, on dedicated breakers with a fixed supply for the compressor. Above four seats the compressor, cooler and dryer double.

The room takes 7 kW of heat while a session runs, and needs 750 l/min of ventilation. In a normally ventilated room with an opening window that is usually met without ductwork. In an enclosed plant room with several concentrators running continuously it is not, and the fix is mechanical ventilation, which is builder’s work and belongs in the programme rather than in the snagging.

System weights, with all equipment: 442 kg at a single seat on the lightest model, 1,063 kg on the Zeugma, 2,589 kg on a four-seat Mediterranean. On a ground-floor slab none of that signifies. On a first floor of a period building it decides the project, and it decides it before anything is drawn.

Pressure, and what the research used

Systems are specified at 2.0, 2.4 or 3.0 ATA. Clinical multiplace systems go to 6.0.

The published research these chambers are built on was dosed at 2.0 ATA, and there are two trials of it.

Hadanny and colleagues, in Aging in 2020, randomised 63 healthy adults over 64 to 60 sessions at 2.0 ATA or to a control arm over three months, and measured cognition. Attention and information processing speed moved most, alongside executive and global cognitive function. The control arm was untreated rather than sham, so the trial does not separate the pressure from the act of attending sixty appointments.

Hadanny and colleagues again, in Sports Medicine – Open in 2022, ran a blinded, randomised, controlled trial of 40 sessions at 2.0 ATA in middle-aged athletes, and measured physical performance and mitochondrial respiration. VO2 max, anaerobic threshold, mitochondrial mass and respiration moved. Strength, jump, sprint and agility did not.

Above 2.0 ATA a chamber has headroom the trials did not test. That is a reason to specify it or not to, depending on what the system is for, and it is worth knowing which side of the evidence a specification sits on.

What reaches the blood

Pressure is one of three things. The others are what is breathed and how fast it is delivered. A built-in breathing system supplies oxygen at 100 per cent at source, about 94 per cent as inhaled once the mask seal is accounted for, at 20 l/min. A standard mask leaks chamber air around the seal and roughly halves that.

At 2.4 ATA on a built-in breathing system, dissolved oxygen in plasma reaches around 5 ml per 100 ml, against about 0.3 ml breathing air at sea level. Two chambers carrying the same pressure rating on the label can deliver different amounts of oxygen, and the mask is where the difference is.

The decision that cannot be undone

A chamber is supplied either on a wellness basis or as a medical device. The manufacturer holds EU MDR certification and can build to it, but the election is made before the vessel goes into production and cannot be added afterwards. A clinic that orders on a wellness basis and later decides to offer a clinical service does not convert the chamber. It buys another one.

Intended purpose at supply is what determines the classification, so the question is not what kind of business is buying. It is what the system will be used for and what will be claimed about it. Dermatology, aesthetic and plastic surgery practices sit on either side of that line depending on the answer, and most of them do not know the question is being asked.

Who will operate it

Operator training runs to sign-off under the International Board of Undersea Medicine: screening, session management, oxygen and fire discipline, records. It is worth asking whether training is a handover or a programme, because a facility that loses its trained operator in year two and cannot replace them has a chamber it cannot run.

What can be changed later, and what cannot

Interior finish and colour
Specified at order. Changed later only by returning the interior
Seating
Specified at order. Upgradable afterwards
Entertainment and monitoring
Added at any point
Extra chamber module
On expandable models. The added air volume doubles the plant
Pressure rating
Before production only
Capacity
Before production only
Medical certification
Before production only

The last three are why the order matters. Everything above them can be revisited over the life of the system. Those three are settled the day the build slot is taken.
